entries.text: A dark age began: the sun has not risen for 5 days.
A new species, the Malebi, branched off the Maleha.
The Maleha are dwindling: from 38 to 17 in 30 days.
Among the Maleno, a group grew apart: the Malebe.
The Devuga multiply: 22 now, 9 a month ago.
The Malesha are dwindling: from 92 to 18 in 30 days.
